svg.title: Emre Kalem arm - ArUco DICT_4X4_50 marker print sheet (A4, print at 100%)
svg.text: FactoryLM / Emre Kalem arm - fiducial marker sheet
ArUco DICT_4X4_50 - 13 stickers - quiet zone 1 module (already inside every white square) - cut on the OUTER line, never inside the INNER line
Generated by Software/arm-vision/make_marker_sheet.py from Software/vision/markers.csv. Do not edit this SVG by hand.
100 mm - MEASURE THIS BEFORE CUTTING ANYTHING
If this line is not exactly 100 mm, the printer rescaled the page.
Reprint at Actual Size / 100% / Scale: None. Do NOT use Fit to Page.
BASE-1 id0 36mm
BASE-2 id1 36mm
HAND-1 id9 25mm
TURRET-1 id2 20mm
TURRET-2 id3 20mm
SHOULDER-1 id4 17mm
ELBOW-1 id6 13mm
WRIST-1 id8 11mm
SHOULDER-2 id5 8mm
HAND-2 id10 8mm
ELBOW-2 id7 6mm
FINGER-A id11 6mm
FINGER-B id12 6mm
BEFORE YOU CUT
1. Print at Actual Size / 100%. Check the 100 mm rule above with a steel rule. Everything on this sheet is wrong if that fails.
2. TWO lines per marker. Cut on the OUTER dashed line: it clears the inner line by 2.4 mm and the next marker by 5.0 mm.
3. The INNER dotted square is the TRIM LIMIT. NEVER cut inside it and never let ink cross it - the white it encloses is the quiet zone
ArUco needs, one module, only 1.0 mm on the smallest markers. Cut inside that line and the marker stops being detected at all.
4. TRIM TO FIT. 9 of 13 cards are LARGER than the surveyed surface they go on - the printed label needs the room, the arm does not
have it. Cut the outer line, offer the sticker up, then trim toward the inner line and never past it. The inner square DOES fit: tightest is
id7/11/12 at 9.6 mm inside a 10.4 mm island. Trimming that far removes the label AND ITS UP-ARROW, so mark the id and the up edge
on the back before you cut - note 5 is why the arrow matters more than the id.
5. The arrow on each label is UP. Apply the sticker that way up every time - a re-applied sticker at a different rotation silently flips the residual sign.
6. The number on the label (e.g. 36mm) is the BLACK SQUARE edge. That is the value you pass to cv2.aruco / solvePnP as the marker length -
NOT the size of the white square you cut out, and NOT the size of the paper card.
7. Matte paper or matte label stock. A gloss finish specular-highlights under the bench lamp and blinds the detector at exactly the angles you care about.
8. Stick each marker only where docs/marker_placement_diagram.svg says. Several faces that look ideal are inner channel walls you cannot reach.
WHAT THIS SHEET IS NOT: a measurement. These are blanks. A sticker yields a CHANGE in orientation, not a joint angle, until the two
calibration passes in Documentation/MARKER-SYSTEM.md section 6 have been run. Detection grades are on the placement diagram, not here:
a grade depends on the camera standoff and on an UNVERIFIED focal length, and a number that can be wrong should not look authoritative.
Sources: Software/vision/markers.csv - Software/vision/stl-face-survey.csv - Documentation/MARKER-SYSTEM.md
